desc:
🧟 Zombies are climbing onto the rooftops. Hold the line!

🔫 Blast wave after wave of zombies and upgrade your guns between runs
👥 Team up in a squad of up to 4, or play solo
💎 Grab diamonds mid-fight to buy bigger guns and drop turrets
🎖️ Pick from many classes, from the Marksman to the Titan robot
🗺️ Fight on 3 maps: Rooftops, Cargo Ship and Subway
🌙 Reach wave 20 to unlock Hard mode and its Blood Moon bosses
⭐ Finish daily and weekly quests to earn stars and rewards
🏆 Climb the Top Survivors boards every season

How far can your squad survive?
